style_prefix: Style: minimal, clean Frutiger Aero. Bright, airy and light, with lots of white space. Smooth glossy aqua glass and soft gel, gentle gradients, soft light, one clear white specular highlight, at most a few small bubbles. Simple shapes, low detail, uncluttered, calm. No plants, no seaweed, no rocks, no fish or other creatures, no busy patterns. Colour palette made only of white, very light sky blue, aqua-cyan (#39C8F0), sky blue (#33C1F0), a touch of Aero blue (#1E6FE0) and small accents of sunny yellow (#FFD93B). Crisp and clean, without any lettering or logos.

home.prefix: The main character is an original anime angel: a graceful adult young woman with long sky-blue twin tails, two small yellow star hair clips, white headphones resting around her neck, a white jacket with sky-blue cuffs over a navy knee-length dress with a small yellow star on the chest, white tights and white boots. She has large soft white feathered angel wings and a thin, faint golden halo. Scene: an angelic yet subtly satanic Frutiger Aero heaven in very light colours only — white, pearl, pale sky blue and soft gold. Layered soft clouds and luminous mist, gentle god-rays, drifting white feathers and a few small glossy glass bubbles. Strong depth: blurred feathers and light in the foreground, the angel in the midground, clouds fading into bright haze far away. A large glowing sunny-yellow inverted pentagram magic circle lies on the cloud floor in deep perspective, its thin luminous lines receding into the distance and partly veiled by mist. Style: polished, painterly anime key-visual illustration with soft shading and fine detail — not flat, not chibi, not a cartoon. No text, no logos, no frames.

items.prompt: Wide 16:9 website background for the home page. She sits sideways on the edge of a soft cloud on the right third, legs crossed at the ankles, leaning slightly forward, one hand resting on the cloud and the other raised holding a small glowing sunny-yellow star; she looks towards the left with a gentle smile, wings half-open behind her. Full figure, large in the frame. The pentagram circle lies on the cloud floor in perspective in the lower centre-right, partly veiled by mist. Keep the left 55% of the image calm and uncluttered — only soft clouds, mist and light — so website content can sit there.

Tall 9:16 phone background for the home page. She sits on a soft cloud in the lower half, legs crossed at the ankles, holding a small glowing sunny-yellow star up in one hand, wings half-open, looking up and to the left with a gentle smile. Full figure, large. The pentagram circle beneath her in perspective. Keep the top 45% calm and uncluttered — only soft sky, mist and light — for website content.

Edit the reference image. Its top strip is a rough, blurry placeholder: repaint that strip as seamless, soft, bright sky and clouds that continue the scene naturally, with no shapes, figures or halos in it. Keep everything else exactly as in the reference — the same angel, pose, face, outfit, wings, halo, clouds, feathers, bubbles, pentagram circle, colours and lighting — with her sitting in the lower part of the frame and open sky above her.

backdrops.prefix: A background with no people, no characters and no creatures: an angelic yet subtly satanic Frutiger Aero heaven in very light colours only — white, pearl, pale sky blue and soft gold. Layered soft clouds, luminous mist, gentle god-rays, a few drifting white feathers and a few small glossy glass bubbles. Calm, airy, low contrast and slightly soft-focus, like a studio backdrop for product shots: the middle of the image stays clear, bright and uncluttered. Isolated on a perfectly flat, uniform solid magenta (#FF00FF) colour field used for cut-out, with nothing else on it and no shadow on it.

Clean anime cel shading, crisp line art, glossy highlights. Full body, the whole figure inside the frame.
